How to Protect Your Instagram Account ‌from Phishing and Scams Instagram has introduced a new​ feature called Security Checkup to help people secure their accounts if they have been ⁤hacked. This feature guides users through steps to secure their accounts, including:
Checking login activity Reviewing profile facts Confirming accounts that share login⁤ information Updating account recovery contact ⁢information‌ such as phone numbers Source
How​ to Protect Instagram Account ‌from Being⁤ Hacked To safeguard ⁤your Instagram account, consider the following basic security‌ measures:
Use Strong and Unique Passwords :⁣ Create a strong and unique password for your Instagram account. Avoid using‌ the same password across multiple ‍platforms. source
Instagram‍ Account Safety & Security Instagram provides several tools to ensure your account remains safe and secure:
Security Checkup : Guides users through ⁣steps⁤ to secure their accounts. Data Security : Measures to protect ⁤your data. Account Recovery : Options to recover⁢ your‍ account if it gets compromised. Instagram also warns against using third-party applications that require your password, as they can compromise your‍ account security. Source
How to Protect Your Instagram Account Enable Two-Factor Authentication : This feature sends a login code to your device when someone tries to log in from an unrecognized‌ device,preventing unauthorized access. Choose Complex Passwords : Use complex and unique passwords to prevent unauthorized access. Avoid using the same password across ⁣multiple accounts. Source
instagram Account Security: An Interview with‌ Instagram’s Chief⁤ Security Officer Q: What are the​ primary measures Instagram takes to ensure data security? one of the primary measures we take to ensure data security on ‍Instagram is implementing stringent encryption protocols.We encrypt users’ data ​both in transit and at rest to protect it from unauthorized access. Additionally, we employ regular security ⁤audits and vulnerability ⁣assessments to identify and address potential threats before they can be exploited.
Q: What ⁤should users do⁤ if their account is compromised? If a user suspects their account has been compromised, they should instantly change their password. They can also use our account recovery options, which include email⁣ verification and recovery codes. If the compromise‍ is‌ meaningful, ⁢users should report it to our support team immediately for further assistance.
Q: Why should users avoid third-party applications ⁤that ask for their Instagram password? Avoiding third-party applications that request your Instagram password is crucial as these apps can potentially compromise your ⁤account security. Instagram does not directly partner with third-party apps that require your password,so using them could lead to unauthorized ‌access or data⁣ breaches. Always⁣ verify the legitimacy of an request before granting access to your account.

Enable Two-Factor Authentication :⁣ This feature sends a‍ login code to your‌ device when someone tries to log in⁤ from an unrecognized device, ⁣preventing unauthorized access.
